meaning: 故事成功部分归因于友谊
usageNote: 注意！这句话其实有语法小毛病，正确说法是 'Part of the story's success is due to the friendship'，is because of 搭配 part of 有点别扭哦！

examples.en: Part of the story's success is due to the deep friendship between the characters.
examples.zh: 这个故事成功的部分原因在于角色之间深厚的友谊。

examples.en: Part of why readers love this book is because of the friendship at its core.
examples.zh: 读者喜爱这本书的部分原因，是因为它核心的友情故事。
